title: Exquisite Gooey Italian Pork Lasagna
description: A funky and gooey Italian dish from Emilia-Romagna, featuring double cream and ferment-jang, perfect for a midnight craving. This kosher-friendly recipe is sure to satisfy your taste buds.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the ground pork over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the ferment-jang to the skillet and stir to combine, cooking for an additional 1-2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the double cream, Parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper, stirring until smooth.
Spread a layer of the cream mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish, followed by a layer of lasagna noodles.
Top the noodles with a layer of the ground pork mixture, followed by a layer of shredded Mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of Mozzarella cheese on top.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
